=== pubspec.yaml
name: calls
=== lib/main.dart
import 'package:calls/src/repository.dart';
import 'package:calls/src/util.dart' as util;

Future<void> main() async {
  final repository = UserRepository(Client());
  repository.save('a');
  const origin = Point.origin();
  final point = Point(1, 2);
  point.move(1);
  helper();
  util.format('x');
  Point.parse('1,2');
  Point.origin().move(2);
  repository.client.send();
  repository.current.move(3);
  for (final user in repository.all()) {
    user.greet();
  }
  (repository as UserRepository).save('b');
  repository
    ..save('c')
    ..reset();
  final fetched = await repository.fetch();
  fetched.greet();
  void local() {}
  local();
  print(origin);
}

void helper() {}
=== lib/src/repository.dart
class Client {
  void send() {}
}

class User {
  void greet() {}
}

class Point {
  Point(this.x, this.y);

  Point.origin() : this(0, 0);

  final int x;
  final int y;

  static Point parse(String s) => Point(0, 0);

  void move(int d) {}
}

class UserRepository {
  UserRepository(this.client);

  final Client client;

  Point get current => Point.origin();

  List<User> all() => [];

  Future<User> fetch() async => User();

  void save(String id) {
    _log(id);
    reset();
  }

  void reset() {}

  void _log(String message) {}
}

class CachedRepository extends UserRepository {
  CachedRepository.named(Client c) : super(c);

  @override
  void save(String id) {
    super.save(id);
  }
}
=== lib/src/util.dart
String format(String s) => s;
